purpose: A2T-ORG-1: the study's first knowledge-organization mechanism on Audio2Tool, at zero contact cost. Every official-population verdict of 2026-09-04 put the Audio2Tool gap in one stratum, smart_home, where 889 of 908 misses name another real registry tool -- roughly half of them the same idea's twin in smart_car (setColor / setColorTemperature / setLighting answered with setAmbientLighting, setFanMode with setFanSpeed) and the rest a same-domain near-synonym (rebootDevice / restartDevice, setSecurityMode / armSecuritySystem, activateScene / activateRoutine, getApplianceState / getApplianceStatus, setLighting / setLightState). The official protocol renders the registry with format_tools_compact, which drops the registry's domain and category columns entirely, so the model is never told which domain a tool belongs to; only 11 of the 53 smart_home descriptions and 28 of the 86 smart_car descriptions mention a domain word. This cell supplies the registry's own domain STRUCTURE, and nothing else, using the release's own second renderer. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-05-a2t-org1-domain-grouped-registry-v1-preregistration.md.
hypothesis: H1: supplying the domain structure of the registry, with no other change, recovers a measurable share of the cross-domain twin misses and therefore of the smart_home gap. The same-domain twins are expected NOT to move; that residual is the target of A2T-ORG-2 (contrast-note rollouts), which is not registered here.

comparators.basis: the sealed official-protocol output of the SAME sample id, under the SAME scorer, from the flight that drew that part of the union roster. Nothing is re-flown on the baseline side: greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch shapes on this runtime, so the sealed bytes are the only honest comparator.

paper_row.paper_column_note: reported beside every tier as the owner's reporting rule requires. It is a CEILING reference, not a gate: this run's decision is a paired delta against the sealed official-protocol cells, never a threshold relative to the published row. arXiv:2604.22821 Table 3 gives no Slot F1 for tier 1.

A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000.strata: tier (500 each over all eight tiers) and domain (smart_home 2,792, wearables 857, smart_car 351)
A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000.selection: NO NEW DRAW: the set-union of the three sealed official-population rosters, id for id (tier 1 500, tiers 2/5/8 1,500, tiers 3/4/6/7 2,000). Builder scripts/build_a2t_org1_union_roster.py verifies each parent's committed SHA-256 and re-derives both of its identity hashes before merging, then re-hashes every wav and re-reads every wav header.
A2T-ORG1-UNION-4000.estimand: the paired effect of the domain-grouped registry on official tool accuracy over the union of the three released populations this repository has already measured under the compact registry

cells.factor: knowledge ORGANIZATION: the registry's own domain structure, supplied by the release's own second renderer
cells.factor_a_output_contract: unchanged from R-official-raw, T1-official-pop-500, T258-official-pop-1500 and T3467-official-pop-2000: the published system-prompt sentence, the fixed '## Available Tools:' header, the same 152 registry rows, the same call-string output contract. ONLY the renderer differs -- format_tools_for_prompt(tools, include_constraints=False) instead of format_tools_compact.
cells.user_turn: audio first, then the fixed sentence 'Convert this voice command to a tool call.'
cells.serving_geometry: -c 49152 -np 2, 24,576 tokens per slot -- the geometry T1-official-pop-500 and T3467-official-pop-2000 flew, re-derived here by the section 8.1 rule against this roster and this system message. The union carries FOUR of the release's 654-second synthesis defects (tier1_direct:003943, tier3_multi_intent:003555, tier6_correction:003151, tier7_multiturn:001033) and no other row over 56 s, so under the mmproj encoder's one-second window rule the worst row costs 8,515 speech tokens. The grouped registry renders to 16,490 chars against the compact's 16,143 (+347), so the text envelope grows by a few hundred tokens at most and -np 2 keeps well over the preregistered 8,192-token reserve while -np 3's 16,384-token slot does not. The prompt-fit receipt measures the real number and re-derives the decision before any generation.
cells.constraints_withheld: include_constraints is FALSE: the release's renderer can also emit a per-tool 'Constraints: ...' line, and it is withheld because it adds ARGUMENT knowledge that would confound the domain-cue question. A constraints cell, if the owner wants one, is a second cell and not an edit to this one.

shared_protocol.harness: core.flight.FlightRuntime with the shared rails zero-supply direct arm and the OpenJiuwen executor, entered through scripts/flights/run_calibration_cell.py -- the same harness and the same entry point every calibration, replication and official-population cell flew
shared_protocol.per_cell_dataset_fragment: this run's single cell is launched with --dataset audio2tool-org1-union-4000; the runner composes model + dataset + baseline + experiment exactly as every earlier Audio2Tool direct cell did

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4,000 rows x 1 contact + 8 canaries = 4,008; the registered exposure ceiling is 4,200
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 23,418.083083 s for one pass (1,668.914042 + 9,784.337875 + 11,964.831167 as the three parents recorded them), rounded up to the integer contracts.ExecutionPlan requires (23,419); the registered exposure ceiling is 24,600
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 1.2. At -np 2 the sealed cells flew 500 rows in 282 s and 2,000 rows in 1,344 s of generation; the 1,500 tiers-2/5/8 rows flew in 934 s at -np 3 and are the short ones. 0.78 to 0.83 s per call over 4,008 calls at two slots projects roughly 2,900 s of generation. The registered ceiling is 2.0
execution_plan_basis.ceilings_live_in_the_exposure_row: contracts.ExecutionPlan carries no ceiling field; the registered ceilings are the exposure-ledger row's calls / speech audio seconds / gpu hours cells, which the gate requires to be at least these planned values, and the budget is cumulative across every attempt of this run id

metrics: official tool accuracy (primary gold tool), pooled and per tier and per domain
official parameter precision/recall/F1, macro over samples as the published code computes it, plus the micro-pooled figure beside it
a2t-toolcall-v2 ordered tool accuracy, exact match and slot F1 under the extended parse
mandatory_slices: POOLED paired delta on official tool accuracy against the sealed official-protocol outputs of the same 4,000 rows: saves / harms / ties, exact sign test, 10,000 bootstrap replicates stratified by tier, seed 20260903, CI90
the same delta on the natural mixture and on equal-domain weighting
per tier, with the paper column beside every tier
per domain (smart_home / wearables / smart_car), and per tier x domain
exact match, parameter F1 macro and micro, a2t-toolcall-v2 and parse rate, each as a paired delta

the confusion-pair table BEFORE and AFTER, counting the named cross-domain twins (setColor / setColorTemperature / setLighting -> setAmbientLighting, setFanMode -> setFanSpeed, setGarageDoor -> setGarageOpener, setVolume -> adjustVolume, findMyDevice -> findPairedPhone) and the named same-domain twins (rebootDevice -> restartDevice, setSecurityMode -> armSecuritySystem, activateScene -> activateRoutine, getApplianceState -> getApplianceStatus, setLighting -> setLightState, getAirQuality -> getAirQuality_diag, setGroupLightState -> setLighting)
the CROSS-DOMAIN SHARE of the gain = (baseline cross-domain-twin misses corrected) / (all misses corrected)

decision.primary: pooled official tool accuracy, ORG-1 minus the sealed official-protocol baseline, paired over 4,000 rows

three_outcomes.admitted: ADMITTED: the pooled CI90 lower bound is above 0 AND the per-domain table shows the gain concentrated on smart_home cross-domain twins. ORG-1 becomes the study's first admitted knowledge-organization mechanism on Audio2Tool, and A2T-ORG-2 is registered on top of it (same roster, ORG-1 as its comparator).
three_outcomes.null: NULL: the CI90 includes 0. Domain structure alone is not the lever; A2T-ORG-2 is registered against the official-protocol baseline instead, and the domain cue is folded into its notes rather than tested again.
three_outcomes.harmful: HARMFUL: the CI90 upper bound is below 0. ORG-1 is dropped and the reason (longer prompt, header tokens) is recorded before ORG-2.

decision.baseline_is_unchanged_by_any_outcome: No outcome changes the direct baseline: the official-protocol cell stays the comparator every mechanism is paired against.
decision.gates_relative_to_the_published_ceiling: The paper column is reported beside every tier as a ceiling reference. No gate is set above it and none is set relative to it: this run's decision is a paired delta and nothing else.
decision.claim_surface: Nothing here is a superiority, generality or Stage-3 claim; the population is discovery data already exposed on 2026-09-04; no knob is tuned on it.
decision.not_authorized: No test contact, no fresh roster, no rollouts, no constraints line, no retrieval or second contact, no change to the direct baseline, no Q8_0, no training-free policy fit. At most one recovery re-registration.

why_one_run_id: All eight tiers fly in ONE roster, ONE split identity hash and ONE run id because ORG-1's estimand is a single pooled paired delta with tier and domain as strata. contracts.gate_exposure requires exactly one pre-registered exposure row per run id whose split identity hash equals the plan's; a single union roster satisfies that, exactly as each of the three parent flights did for its own draw.
